author: (H. Adams & A. Adams, 1854)

note.en: A small clam that nests in crevices and borings of rock and rubble in shallow water; four museum samples from Cahuita reef and Punta Mona.
note.es: Una almeja pequeña que anida en grietas y perforaciones de roca y escombros en aguas someras; cuatro muestras de museo del arrecife de Cahuita y Punta Mona.

evidence: GBIF: 4 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections)

sources.t: Espinosa & Ortea 2001, Moluscos del mar Caribe de Costa Rica (REGAMA and Cahuita catalogue), Avicennia

recWhy: Recorded: GBIF: 4 record(s) in the region, mostly museum specimens (Universidad de Costa Rica collections).

marks.en: Small, thin, whitish elongate shell with a blunt end, often found boring or nestling in crevices.
marks.es: Concha pequeña, fina y blanquecina alargada con un extremo romo, que suele vivir en grietas u horadando.
